# netbox_group (Data Source)

A user group (users.group).

From the [official documentation](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/users/group/):

> A group is a collection of [users](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/users/user/) which share a common set of permissions. Assigning [object permissions](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/users/objectpermission/) to a group, rather than to individual users, simplifies the administration of permissions for related users (e.g. members of a particular team).
>
> A user inherits the union of all permissions assigned to each group of which they are a member, in addition to any permissions assigned directly to the user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_group" "test" {
  name = "test-group"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `name` (String)
- `name_contains` (String) Case-insensitive substring of the name.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String)
- `url` (String)
- `user_count` (Number) Number of users in the group.
